    • Uses of SupervisorNotificationI in fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy.plugins.devs.connections

      Classes in fr.sorbonne_u.components.cyphy.plugins.devs.connections that implement SupervisorNotificationI 
      Modifier and Type Class and Description
      class  SupervisorNotificationConnector
      The class SupervisorNotificationConnector implements the connector to be used for the notification of simulation reports to the simulation client component.
      class  SupervisorNotificationInboundPort
      The class SupervisorNotificationInboundPort implements the inbound port used by simulation supervisor components to connect with the simulators and the coordinators and to receive their simulation reports.
      class  SupervisorNotificationOutboundPort
      The class SupervisorNotificationOutboundPort implements the outbound port used by simulation components to notify their simulation reports.
